title: Dragon Grove: Emberwild — dragon appearance
modifications: 2K body colour/normal textures, 1K roughness and 512px eye/teeth maps, embedded in GLB; original mesh topology, skeleton and animation clips preserved.
Eleven body states: an initial newborn and ten earned evolutions. Stage-specific head, neck, wing, chest, limb, paw and tail proportions are applied after the animation sampler.
A shared-topology crown morph moves from tiny newborn buds through the original horn shape to elongated mature horns. Warm crown markings and raised-scale contrast develop with age.
Wing finger proportions broaden the existing membranes; the source Fly wing pose is progressively blended into the standing pose as wings unfold.
Independent Fire, Storm, Nature and Astral skin masks, with additional inherited chest, wing and tail proportions. Affinity channels accumulate independently.
A deliberate screen-size budget increases at every stage, with a stable projected ground line. Mature appearances are no longer auto-fitted to the same apparent size.
Three-quarter camera, soft contact shadow, image-based forest scene, warm key and cool rim lighting.

inheritance.fire: Warm crest markings and broader chest.
inheritance.storm: Cool wing membrane markings and longer wings.
inheritance.nature: Forest scale markings and a longer tail.
inheritance.astral: Violet wing and crest markings, and broader wing proportions.
inheritance.combination: All four channels accumulate independently; none replaces another.

animation.runtime: Source Idle Sit/Idle Stand is sampled by a 169-joint skeleton. A sampled source Fly wing pose blends into the growth stance. Breath adds an animated jaw/head overlay. Growth proportions are reapplied after animation sampling.
animation.limits: The source does not include a bespoke fire-breath animation. The runtime supplements it with a jaw/head pose and mouth-attached effects.

framing.perStage: The stage frame multiplier scales both screen budgets. Fit uses projected skinned vertices; the same stage/path state reuses its cached points and camera. Stages 7–10 gradually turn the view towards the chest, with a restrained wing fan so the face and body remain visible between the wings.
framing.persistence: These appearance fields are derived in the renderer. Saved stage numbers, paths, progress and rewards are unchanged.

generatedTextures.creator: Original asset created for Bright Quest with OpenAI image generation
generatedTextures.prompt: A realistic dragon fire-breath VFX plume on transparent background, left narrow nozzle expanding right into turbulent orange/amber flames, pale yellow core, wispy irregular tongues and translucent smoke edges. Entire plume visible with clear padding; no scenery, text, border or black background.
